summary: Tested Pulse Pro trial once-per-org + dismissible banner + Master Admin re-grant (backend pytest + UI) and Lite-owner All-sites default. Backend core flow 100% pass (state, dismiss, once-only 409, master grant -> available again -> used -> unavailable, non-master 403, 404). UI: banner card titles now white (rgb 255,255,255) and readable; X dismiss hides banner and it stays hidden after reload; Account settings > Plan & Billing shows pulse-pro-upgrade-cta-settings with Try button (no X); Lite owner lands on All Operations Sites with switcher; Master Admin Billing tab shows org-pro-trial box, 'Allocate another trial' works and status updates. FOUND: (1) Lite owner cannot switch to a different single site from the switcher - bounces back to All sites. (2) Once-per-org bypass: POST /api/me/upgrade-to-pro with {} upgrades a used-trial Lite org to pulse_pro for free.

critical.issue: Once-per-org check only runs when start_trials is non-empty (line 190). An org that already used its trial, back on lite, can POST {} (or start_trials:[]) and is flipped to account_type='pulse_pro' with no trial expiry and no payment. Verified: available=false -> POST {} -> 200 {account_type:'pulse_pro', trials_started:[]}. Either always enforce the check for self-serve upgrades, or require a paid path for no-trial upgrades.

minor.issue: No owner/manager check - any authenticated org user (e.g. staff) can permanently dismiss the banner for the whole organisation. Consider _require_owner_or_master or managerial check.

ui_bugs.issue: Lite owner picking a DIFFERENT site in the site switcher stays on All Operations Sites (all-sites-overview still shown, per-site tabs not shown). localStorage active_site_cache does update. Picking the same site a second time works. RCA: AppRoutes renders <Routes key={siteKey}> so changing activeSite remounts LiteDashboardPage; ownerAllSitesApplied useRef resets on remount and the effect at L139-143 sets allSitesActive=true again. Fix: initialise allSitesActive from auth allSitesMode (or localStorage 'active_site_all'), and only apply the owner default when no explicit site choice is stored (e.g. no active_site_cache) - or persist the 'applied' flag in sessionStorage.

issues: Bolt-on cards are too narrow in the modal: descriptions wrap to 4-5 lines and 'Email/SMS/push' / 'Memberships' text overflows past card edges. Use 1-col or stacked layout at this width.
On 429 rate limit ('Too many requests') the login form shows no visible error - Sign In just does nothing.
'Upgrade Plan' button is light-blue with white text - low contrast.

action_items: Fix site-switcher bounce-back for Lite owners (remount resets ownerAllSitesApplied ref) - see RCA
Close once-per-org bypass in /api/me/upgrade-to-pro when start_trials is empty
Fix cramped bolt-on cards in settings CTA; show error on 429 at login

LiteDashboardPage L136-143: owner default should respect persisted site choice, since <Routes key={siteKey}> remounts the page
GrantProTrialButton 'used' check depends on the org list payload including pro_trial_used_at/module_trials - works today, keep in sync
LiteDashboardPage.js is 1337 lines - should be split

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested flows (1 HIGH loophole found)
